description: Minimum burial cover of a power cable by country, voltage and place (open ground, road, pavement; direct or in a raceway for US and AU), from that country's rule with its source and seen level, or null with the reason. Free, no LLM. Notes: thecablecode://guide/burial_depth.

method.description: direct (default) or raceway (duct or conduit); the US and Australian rules tell them apart.

place.description: field (open ground, default), road or pavement.

u.description: U in kV (1 for 0.6/1 kV, 20 for 12/20 kV) or Uo/U such as "0.6/1".

name: burial_depth
title: Minimum burial depth of a cable by country
